Arcane Studies.name: Arcane Studies
Arcane Studies.description: Begin with Arcane Magic at skill level 3, linked to Logic. You have practiced a small repertoire of introductory effects, using actual tools and the shared Mana rules. This choice represents learned study, not a natural affinity. It does not imply academy enrollment or exceptional mastery. Other schools remain learnable. The studied introductory effects use practiced personal blueprints. Body casting is available through training without a required purchase; a catalyst can help. Speech or gestures are aids rather than universal requirements. Your initial named techniques are Mana Knock and Halfmoon Pane. Other library techniques remain learnable choices, not automatic ownership.

Force Training.name: Force Training
Force Training.description: Committed physical power, leverage, and heavy or unarmed fighting. Begin with Force Combat at skill level 3. Your actual equipment and stated experience determine the weapons you know. You may combine an introductory learned magical infusion with a physically delivered attack: one primary check, the actual Mana cost, no duplicated hit or added skill total. This is no automatic advanced technique or proficiency with every weapon. Your initial named techniques are Hammering Entry and Shoulder Through. Other library techniques remain learnable choices, not automatic ownership.

Hair Color — Black.name: Hair Color — Black

Hair Color — Mint green.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Mint green. Exact base-color reference: #A7DFC7. Visual identity: pale pastel mint; distinguish from emerald. Hair Style — Cropped.name: Hair Style — Cropped
Hair Style — Cropped.description: Short, close-cut hair follows the head with a little natural texture on top. A tidy silhouette keeps the forehead, ears and facial features in focus without requiring a formal style.
Hair Style — Cropped.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the hair close to the head with a softly textured top. There is enough length for a breeze to make a suggestion, and not much more.

Hair Style — Tousled.name: Hair Style — Tousled
Hair Style — Tousled.description: Lightly disheveled locks fall in deliberately uneven directions, with soft flyaways and a few loose pieces framing the face. Casual, not an extreme spiked hairstyle.
Hair Style — Tousled.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the relaxed, finger-combed irregularity. At least one stray lock seems firmly opposed to the concept of a comb.

Hair Style — Bob.name: Hair Style — Bob
Hair Style — Bob.description: A clean chin-to-neck-length bob with a strong rounded or blunt outline, the ends framing the jaw. Refined enough for a formal portrait, easygoing enough for an ordinary afternoon.
Hair Style — Bob.traitNarrativeEffects: Maintain the recognizable jaw-length bob; its ends swing together when the head turns, as though the haircut rehearsed the movement.

Hair Style — Shoulder-length.name: Hair Style — Shoulder-length
Hair Style — Shoulder-length.description: Hair reaches the shoulders and brushes the collar, with a natural, easy drape. A versatile middle length that leaves the texture to the character rather than forcing curls or bangs.
Hair Style — Shoulder-length.traitNarrativeEffects: The ends graze the shoulders and fall free again. Keep the medium-long silhouette without quietly growing it down the back.

Hair Style — Long and straight.name: Hair Style — Long and straight
Hair Style — Long and straight.description: Long, smooth, predominantly straight lengths fall well below the shoulders. Clean vertical lines and fine strand highlights create an elegant, flowing silhouette.
Hair Style — Long and straight.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve the long straight lengths and their weight. A turn of the head sends them sliding after it, a very modest private special effect.

Hair Style — Long and wavy.name: Hair Style — Long and wavy
Hair Style — Long and wavy.description: Long hair flows beyond the shoulders in broad, soft S-shaped waves. The texture adds body and movement without becoming tightly curled or rigidly styled.
Hair Style — Long and wavy.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve loose flowing waves rather than ringlets. Passing air and this hairstyle appear to have a remarkably cooperative arrangement.

Hair Style — Ponytail.name: Hair Style — Ponytail
Hair Style — Ponytail.description: Hair gathered into one classic mid-height ponytail behind the head, with the loose length falling down the back. The tie is simple and the silhouette unmistakable.
Hair Style — Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep one ponytail at a moderate height; its swaying tail is usually a fraction of a second behind the conversation.

Hair Style — Braid.name: Hair Style — Braid
Hair Style — Braid.description: One long, clearly woven braid collects the hair into an interlaced plait down the back or over a shoulder. Distinct crossing strands make the construction visible.
Hair Style — Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep a single woven braid, not a ponytail. The braid remains disciplined even when a few face-framing strands resign.

Hair Style — Twintails.name: Hair Style — Twintails
Hair Style — Twintails.description: Hair parted into two equal sections and tied into matching tails at either side of the head. The paired lengths give a lively, balanced anime silhouette.
Hair Style — Twintails.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve two distinct tied tails and their symmetry. They have a habit of bouncing in slightly different time signatures.

Hair Style — Drill twintails.name: Hair Style — Drill twintails
Hair Style — Drill twintails.description: Two tied tails shaped into bold, elongated spiral curls, each twisting into a recognizable corkscrew. Deliberately dramatic, symmetrical and unmistakably anime.
Hair Style — Drill twintails.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep both spiral drills fully readable, not ordinary curls. The hairstyle arrives with enough presence that introductions seem optional.

Hair Style — Pinned up.name: Hair Style — Pinned up
Hair Style — Pinned up.description: Hair lifted and secured off the neck with pins or discreet fastenings, forming a composed updo. A few soft wisps can loosen the form without disguising the pinned structure.
Hair Style — Pinned up.traitNarrativeEffects: The gathered hair stays fastened away from the neck. One escaped wisp is allowed to question the excellent planning.

Practiced Finesse Combat.traitNarrativeEffects: Increase Finesse Combat by 3. Requires prior training in this skill; grants no new discipline, spell, affinity or equipment.

Practiced Guarded Combat.name: Practiced Guarded Combat
Practiced Guarded Combat.description: Increase Guarded Combat by 3. Requires prior training in this skill; grants no new discipline, spell, affinity or equipment.
Practiced Guarded Combat.traitNarrativeEffects: Increase Guarded Combat by 3. Requires prior training in this skill; grants no new discipline, spell, affinity or equipment.

Practiced Space Magic.name: Practiced Space Magic
Practiced Space Magic.description: Increase Space Magic by 3. Requires prior training in this skill; grants no new discipline, spell, affinity or equipment.
Practiced Space Magic.traitNarrativeEffects: Increase Space Magic by 3. Requires prior training in this skill; grants no new discipline, spell, affinity or equipment.

Practiced Soul Magic.name: Practiced Soul Magic
Practiced Soul Magic.description: Increase Soul Magic by 3. Requires prior training in this skill; grants no new discipline, spell, affinity or equipment.
Practiced Soul Magic.traitNarrativeEffects: Increase Soul Magic by 3. Requires prior training in this skill; grants no new discipline, spell, affinity or equipment.

Hair Color - Jet Black.name: Hair Color - Jet Black
Hair Color - Jet Black.description: An inky near-absolute black with the faintest blue-neutral reflected highlights. Darker and glossier in effect than natural black. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Jet Black.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Jet Black. Exact base-color reference: #101015. Visual identity: near-absolute jet black; preserve black even under strong lighting. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Ash Brown.name: Hair Color - Ash Brown
Hair Color - Ash Brown.description: A muted cool taupe-brown with an ashy finish, soft gray-beige undertones and almost no red or golden warmth. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Ash Brown.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Ash Brown. Exact base-color reference: #71645F. Visual identity: cool ashy taupe-brown; not warm chestnut. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Auburn.name: Hair Color - Auburn
Hair Color - Auburn.description: A deep reddish-brown with a noticeable ember-red undertone, warmer than burgundy but darker and earthier than copper. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Auburn.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Auburn. Exact base-color reference: #8F372F. Visual identity: deep red-brown; separate from copper and burgundy. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Burgundy.name: Hair Color - Burgundy
Hair Color - Burgundy.description: A dark wine-red with a cool plum undertone. Its red-purple richness becomes visible in the light without turning bright crimson. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Burgundy.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Burgundy. Exact base-color reference: #65263B. Visual identity: deep wine burgundy; not crimson or violet. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Golden Blond.name: Hair Color - Golden Blond
Hair Color - Golden Blond.description: A bright sunlit gold-blond with luminous yellow-gold highlights. Warmer and clearer than honey-blond, without turning orange. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Golden Blond.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Golden Blond. Exact base-color reference: #E5BA59. Visual identity: bright golden blond; not honey-blond or platinum. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Ginger.name: Hair Color - Ginger
Hair Color - Ginger.description: A lively natural orange-red with a warm ginger base and light copper highlights, bright but grounded rather than fluorescent. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Ginger.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Ginger. Exact base-color reference: #D47539. Visual identity: natural ginger orange-red; distinguish from copper. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Ash gray.name: Hair Color - Ash gray
Hair Color - Ash gray.description: A medium neutral-cool ash gray with faint smoky highlights. Understated and matte compared with luminous silver. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Ash gray.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Ash gray. Exact base-color reference: #96979A. Visual identity: medium smoky ash gray; not metallic silver. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Midnight Blue.name: Hair Color - Midnight Blue
Hair Color - Midnight Blue.description: A very dark indigo-navy that can look almost black in shadow but reveals unmistakable blue along the lit strands. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Midnight Blue.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Midnight Blue. Exact base-color reference: #202C61. Visual identity: deep midnight navy; ensure visible blue in highlights. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Lavender.name: Hair Color - Lavender
Hair Color - Lavender.description: A delicate pastel lavender with soft cool lilac undertones, light and airy rather than saturated purple. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Lavender.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Lavender. Exact base-color reference: #B7A0DA. Visual identity: pastel lavender; not deep violet. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Coral.name: Hair Color - Coral
Hair Color - Coral.description: A warm pink-orange coral, balancing peach and rosy red in a bright yet softly rendered anime palette. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Coral.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Coral. Exact base-color reference: #F18C83. Visual identity: salmon-coral pink-orange; not rose pink or sunset orange. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Emerald Green.name: Hair Color - Emerald Green
Hair Color - Emerald Green.description: A rich jewel-green with cool forest undertones and bright emerald accents, confidently green rather than teal. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Emerald Green.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Emerald Green. Exact base-color reference: #1E9163. Visual identity: saturated emerald green; not mint or blue-green teal. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Rose Gold.name: Hair Color - Rose Gold
Hair Color - Rose Gold.description: A muted rosy champagne tone with peach-gold warmth and a soft pink sheen, elegant without a metallic hair texture. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Rose Gold.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Rose Gold. Exact base-color reference: #D8A0A0. Visual identity: muted pink-champagne rose gold; not rose pink. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Color - Sunset Orange.name: Hair Color - Sunset Orange
Hair Color - Sunset Orange.description: A vivid sunset orange with a red-orange base and warm apricot highlights, brighter and more saturated than natural ginger. Anime-style shading should add clean strand highlights while keeping the dominant color unmistakable.
Hair Color - Sunset Orange.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Sunset Orange. Exact base-color reference: #EF743D. Visual identity: bright sunset orange; distinct from ginger and coral. Apply consistently to portraits and narration until a change in the story. Lighting may change brightness and shadows, not the underlying hue. Cosmetic only.

Hair Style — Short and straight.name: Hair Style — Short and straight
Hair Style — Short and straight.description: Short, straight strands lie in clean, simple sections around the head, above the shoulders. Softly defined ends frame the face without curls or bulky volume.
Hair Style — Short and straight.traitNarrativeEffects: Maintain short straight strands and a compact outline. Even after a windy afternoon, the haircut is remarkably easy to negotiate with.

Hair Style — Short and wavy.name: Hair Style — Short and wavy
Hair Style — Short and wavy.description: A short cut with gentle curved waves and a little lift through the crown. The texture gives the outline softness and body without producing tight curls.
Hair Style — Short and wavy.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep short, clearly wavy texture. A breeze rearranges it and somehow improves its own previous work.

Hair Style — Short and curly.name: Hair Style — Short and curly
Hair Style — Short and curly.description: Short, defined curls cluster around the crown and sides, giving springy, compact volume. Individual ringlets or coils remain legible without hanging far down the neck.
Hair Style — Short and curly.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve visible short curls rather than generic fluffy volume. Each coil seems to have read a different weather forecast.

Hair Style — Medium and straight.name: Hair Style — Medium and straight
Hair Style — Medium and straight.description: Neck-to-shoulder-length straight hair falls in smooth sections beside the face, with a balanced, practical silhouette. The ends stay clearly below a short cut but above long hair.
Hair Style — Medium and straight.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the straight mid-length shape. It tends to settle back into place as though it remembers the portrait reference.

Hair Style — Medium and wavy.name: Hair Style — Medium and wavy
Hair Style — Medium and wavy.description: Soft S-shaped waves give neck-to-shoulder-length hair a gently textured outline. Loose bends catch highlights and add movement without heavy curls.
Hair Style — Medium and wavy.traitNarrativeEffects: Maintain distinct medium waves. They hold their shape through ordinary scenes and negotiate their own terms with the wind.

Hair Style — Medium and curly.name: Hair Style — Medium and curly
Hair Style — Medium and curly.description: Medium-length curls frame the face and reach toward the shoulders, building a fuller silhouette with defined spirals or coils.
Hair Style — Medium and curly.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the curls clearly defined at shoulder level. The silhouette is cheerful about volume, regardless of its owner’s mood.

Hair Style — Long and curly.name: Hair Style — Long and curly
Hair Style — Long and curly.description: Long cascades of distinct curls flow well past the shoulders, creating a rich, textured outline. Ringlets and coils overlap without becoming a single wavy sheet.
Hair Style — Long and curly.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve abundant long curls. When they move, they take the scenic route and arrive beautifully.

Hair Style — Pixie cut.name: Hair Style — Pixie cut
Hair Style — Pixie cut.description: A very short, shaped cut with cropped sides and nape and slightly longer feathered pieces on top. The fringe and crown can be playfully textured while keeping the face open.
Hair Style — Pixie cut.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the precise pixie silhouette and exposed neck. A tiny flick at the crown can do the work of a much larger hairstyle.

Hair Style — Buzz cut.name: Hair Style — Buzz cut
Hair Style — Buzz cut.description: Hair clipped to an even, very short stubble across the scalp. A faint visible texture distinguishes it from a fully shaved head.
Hair Style — Buzz cut.traitNarrativeEffects: Retain the uniform, close buzzed texture. The haircut has little patience for stray strands, mostly because it has none to spare.

Hair Style — Layered.name: Hair Style — Layered
Hair Style — Layered.description: Hair cut into clear overlapping lengths, with shorter pieces framing the face and longer sections giving depth. The layers create natural movement without prescribing a fixed overall length.
Hair Style — Layered.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the overlapping steps visible rather than one blunt edge. Each layer takes a small turn catching the light.

Hair Style — Messy.name: Hair Style — Messy
Hair Style — Messy.description: A deliberately untidy arrangement of uneven strands, stray locks and gently chaotic volume. It looks lived-in rather than immaculately combed, without turning into hard spikes.
Hair Style — Messy.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve the disordered texture. The mirror, the comb and the hair appear to have reached three separate agreements.

Hair Style — Bun.name: Hair Style — Bun
Hair Style — Bun.description: Hair neatly gathered into one rounded bun at the back or crown, with a secure, recognizable coil. The neck remains mostly clear and the shape stays compact.
Hair Style — Bun.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep one neatly gathered bun and a clear nape. A runaway strand may appear, but the architecture remains sound.

Hair Style — Messy bun.name: Hair Style — Messy bun
Hair Style — Messy bun.description: Hair loosely twisted into one bun with airy loops, flyaways and escaped wisps around the temples. The gathered shape is clear, but intentionally not pristine.
Hair Style — Messy bun.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the loosely secured bun and its escaping pieces. The hairpins seem to be surviving on confidence alone.

Hair Style — Half-up, half-down.name: Hair Style — Half-up, half-down
Hair Style — Half-up, half-down.description: The upper half of the hair is tied or pinned back while the rest falls freely over the shoulders. The contrast between controlled crown and loose lengths defines the style.
Hair Style — Half-up, half-down.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve the distinct gathered upper section and flowing lower hair. One half attends the meeting; the other half is already enjoying the breeze.

Hair Style — Side-parted.name: Hair Style — Side-parted
Hair Style — Side-parted.description: A clear off-center part sends more hair across one side of the forehead, creating an asymmetrical frame for the face. The cut and length remain otherwise flexible.
Hair Style — Side-parted.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the side part visible and avoid drifting back to center. One temple gets the spotlight and is entirely comfortable with that.

Hair Style — Middle-parted.name: Hair Style — Middle-parted
Hair Style — Middle-parted.description: A distinct center part divides the hair into two balanced sections framing the face. The symmetry works with many lengths and textures without prescribing either.
Hair Style — Middle-parted.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep a readable central part. The left and right sides have reached a diplomatic agreement, at least for the portrait.

Hair Style — Slicked back.name: Hair Style — Slicked back
Hair Style — Slicked back.description: Hair smoothed backward from the forehead with clean direction and controlled volume. The face remains fully visible; the finish can be neat or softly glossy.
Hair Style — Slicked back.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the strands swept away from the forehead. Not a single lock appears interested in covering the eyes.

Hair Style — Bangs.name: Hair Style — Bangs
Hair Style — Bangs.description: A visible fringe falls over the forehead, from light wisps to a fuller blunt line, framing the eyes without hiding them completely. The fringe is the distinguishing feature.
Hair Style — Bangs.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the bangs readable across the forehead. A tiny shift in the fringe can produce an entirely new expression.

Hair Style — Side-swept bangs.name: Hair Style — Side-swept bangs
Hair Style — Side-swept bangs.description: Longer fringe strands sweep diagonally across the forehead toward one temple, forming an angled line above the eyes. Soft, directional and visibly asymmetrical.
Hair Style — Side-swept bangs.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve the diagonal fringe and its chosen side. It occasionally drifts across one eyebrow to make a point.

Hair Style — Curtain bangs.name: Hair Style — Curtain bangs
Hair Style — Curtain bangs.description: A center-parted fringe opens into two curved face-framing sections, longer at the sides and swept away from the eyes. The split is distinct from full straight bangs.
Hair Style — Curtain bangs.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the two outward-curving fringe pieces. They part around the face with excellent stage timing.

Hair Style — High ponytail.name: Hair Style — High ponytail
Hair Style — High ponytail.description: Hair pulled tightly or smoothly into a single ponytail secured high on the crown, with its length rising before falling behind. The high tie creates a buoyant silhouette.
Hair Style — High ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the tie high on the crown. The ponytail makes every quick turn just a little more dramatic.

Hair Style — Low ponytail.name: Hair Style — Low ponytail
Hair Style — Low ponytail.description: A single ponytail secured close to the nape, the length hanging down the back in an understated line. Relaxed or polished, but never tied high.
Hair Style — Low ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the tie low at the neck. It is a practical style that prefers not to interrupt its owner’s business.

Hair Style — Side ponytail.name: Hair Style — Side ponytail
Hair Style — Side ponytail.description: Hair gathered into one ponytail secured to the left or right, with the loose length visible beside the cheek or over a shoulder. Its one-sided silhouette is the point.
Hair Style — Side ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the ponytail to one side, not centered at the back. It has clearly chosen its preferred camera angle.

Hair Style — Side braid.name: Hair Style — Side braid
Hair Style — Side braid.description: One interwoven braid lies along a side of the head and comes forward over a shoulder, with its crossing strands clearly visible from the front.
Hair Style — Side braid.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve the single side braid. It has done the unusual courtesy of showing its best detail to the viewer.

Hair Style — French braid.name: Hair Style — French braid
Hair Style — French braid.description: A close-to-scalp braid starts near the crown and incorporates hair section by section toward the nape, then may continue as a free plait. The integrated woven pattern is visible.
Hair Style — French braid.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the braid woven into the head before it falls free. The meticulous pattern is a quiet little feat of engineering.

Hair Style — Double braids.name: Hair Style — Double braids
Hair Style — Double braids.description: Hair divided into two sections, each woven into its own distinct plait, falling on either side of the face or down the back. Balanced twin woven lengths.
Hair Style — Double braids.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve two separate braids. They travel together but rarely swing at exactly the same moment.

Hair Style — Double buns.name: Hair Style — Double buns
Hair Style — Double buns.description: Two rounded buns sit on opposite sides of the crown, balanced in size and placement. The paired coils create a clear playful silhouette without becoming ponytails.
Hair Style — Double buns.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep both buns rounded and distinct. The hairstyle is remarkably efficient at being recognizable from a distance.

Hair Style — Wolf cut.name: Hair Style — Wolf cut
Hair Style — Wolf cut.description: A shaggy, heavily layered cut with a fuller textured crown and thinner longer lengths around the neck. The contrast gives the outline a softly wild shape.
Hair Style — Wolf cut.traitNarrativeEffects: Maintain the full choppy crown and wispy trailing nape. Even the well-behaved strands look ready for an adventure.

Hair Style — Hime cut.name: Hair Style — Hime cut
Hair Style — Hime cut.description: Long straight hair falls behind a dramatic pair of blunt cheek-length side locks, usually with a straight forehead fringe. Strong geometric face framing defines this classic look.
Hair Style — Hime cut.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the blunt cheek panels, fringe and longer rear lengths distinct. The lines are so precise they could probably judge a ruler.

Hair Style — Hime bob.name: Hair Style — Hime bob
Hair Style — Hime bob.description: A short bob incorporates the hime cut’s blunt cheek-framing sections and defined fringe, replacing the long back with a jaw-to-neck-length silhouette.
Hair Style — Hime bob.traitNarrativeEffects: Maintain the sharp hime side locks in a shorter bob. Every edge appears to have arrived at precisely the intended length.

Hair Style — Shag cut.name: Hair Style — Shag cut
Hair Style — Shag cut.description: Many soft, choppy layers build volume at the crown and feather out into irregular, lighter ends. Relaxed, textured and deliberately imperfect.
Hair Style — Shag cut.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the chopped layers and airy ends. The haircut gives the impression that a good story happened just before the scene started.

Hair Style — Mullet.name: Hair Style — Mullet
Hair Style — Mullet.description: Hair is shorter at the front and sides but distinctly longer at the back, with a visible contrast in lengths. The difference may be modern and subtle or sharply expressive.
Hair Style — Mullet.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve the short-front, long-back silhouette. It offers a different introduction depending on which way the character turns.

Hair Style — Undercut.name: Hair Style — Undercut
Hair Style — Undercut.description: A noticeably shorter or shaved section sits under longer hair on top, typically at the sides or nape. The contrast should remain visible rather than disappearing into an ordinary fade.
Hair Style — Undercut.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the close-cut underlayer beneath longer top hair. A turn of the head reveals the hairstyle’s excellent second act.

Hair Style — Fade.name: Hair Style — Fade
Hair Style — Fade.description: The hair transitions smoothly from very short near the temples and nape to longer higher up, producing a clean graduated blend rather than a hard shaved line.
Hair Style — Fade.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve the gradual fade with no sudden undercut edge. Its precision is clearest when angled light crosses the sides.

Hair Style — Pompadour.name: Hair Style — Pompadour
Hair Style — Pompadour.description: The front hair rises into a prominent rounded wave before sweeping backward, while the sides stay more controlled. High, sculpted volume above the forehead is essential.
Hair Style — Pompadour.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the elevated front sweep. Doorframes have not actually become lower; the hairstyle merely makes them seem cautious.

Hair Style — Afro.name: Hair Style — Afro
Hair Style — Afro.description: Tightly coiled or naturally kinky hair forms a rounded, full silhouette with visible small-scale texture. The shape may be compact or generously voluminous, but not straightened.
Hair Style — Afro.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve natural coils and the rounded outline. Under backlight, the silhouette needs very little help making an entrance.

Hair Style — Dreadlocks.name: Hair Style — Dreadlocks
Hair Style — Dreadlocks.description: Hair forms distinct mature locs, fine or thick, hanging with visible individual weight and texture. They can be long or short, but are not loose braids or smooth strands.
Hair Style — Dreadlocks.traitNarrativeEffects: Maintain distinct individual locs and their natural weight. Each one moves with its own deliberate sense of timing.

Hair Style — Cornrows.name: Hair Style — Cornrows
Hair Style — Cornrows.description: Hair braided tightly and closely along the scalp in continuous rows, straight or gently patterned. The scalp-following lines must be clearly legible.
Hair Style — Cornrows.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the braids close against the scalp in clean rows. Their pattern is best appreciated from more than one angle.

Hair Style — Box braids.name: Hair Style — Box braids
Hair Style — Box braids.description: Hair is divided into small sections and braided into many separate lengths, with the neat parting grid visible near the roots. Distinct from cornrows laid flat against the scalp.
Hair Style — Box braids.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve the many individual braids and their sectioned roots. The pattern is as thoughtful as any carefully plotted map.

Hair Style — Mohawk.name: Hair Style — Mohawk
Hair Style — Mohawk.description: A strong central strip of longer hair runs from the forehead toward the nape, with closely clipped or shaved sides. The raised crest can be spiked, swept or textured.
Hair Style — Mohawk.traitNarrativeEffects: Keep the tall central crest and sharply shorter sides. The hairstyle has never once tried to enter a room unnoticed.

Mana Wellspring.name: Mana Wellspring
Mana Wellspring.description: Increase maximum Mana by 40. This increases capacity, not regeneration or casting power.
Mana Wellspring.traitNarrativeEffects: A deep, well-developed reserve of usable casting mana. Increase maximum Mana by 40 once. This trait is not a potion, an immediate repeated refill, cheaper spells, access to vital mana, or passive Mana recovery.

Boundless Vigor.name: Boundless Vigor
Boundless Vigor.description: Increase maximum Stamina by 20. This increases exertion capacity, not passive recovery.
Boundless Vigor.traitNarrativeEffects: Conditioned endurance allows more demanding exertion before the Stamina pool is exhausted. Increase maximum Stamina by 20 once. Ordinary movement remains free; this grants no bonus actions, passive Stamina recharge, or immunity to fatigue or injuries.

Battle-Hardened.name: Battle-Hardened
Battle-Hardened.description: +25 maximum Health and +1 Guarded Combat. Requires prior Guarded Combat training.
Battle-Hardened.traitNarrativeEffects: Learned endurance and defensive experience. Apply the listed Health-capacity and Guarded Combat bonuses once; this does not independently grant damage resistance, armor, free counters, or healing.

Arcane Discipline.name: Arcane Discipline
Arcane Discipline.description: +20 maximum Mana and +1 spellcraft. Requires prior Spellcraft training.
Arcane Discipline.traitNarrativeEffects: Careful practice expands usable Mana and familiarity with spell design. This increases capacity and Spellcraft, not the power or knowledge of every magical school. No passive Mana recovery, free casts, or invented spells.

Conditioned Athlete.name: Conditioned Athlete
Conditioned Athlete.description: +12 maximum Stamina and +1 athletics. Requires prior Athletics training.
Conditioned Athlete.traitNarrativeEffects: Long-term physical conditioning improves strenuous action capacity and athletics skill. This does not charge Stamina for ordinary walking or grant regeneration, free special actions, or automatic success.

Spellblade Conditioning.name: Spellblade Conditioning
Spellblade Conditioning.description: +15 maximum Mana, +10 maximum Stamina, and +1 Finesse Combat. Requires prior Finesse Combat training.
Spellblade Conditioning.traitNarrativeEffects: A hybrid foundation for precise fighting and magic. Apply listed bonuses once. Spells still require actual learned disciplines and Mana, and mixed maneuvers still pay authored costs. This grants no free spell, magical affinity, duplicate accuracy check, or extra attack.

Keen Investigator.name: Keen Investigator
Keen Investigator.description: +2 investigation and +1 Perception. Requires prior Investigation training.
Keen Investigator.traitNarrativeEffects: Experience at examining evidence and noticing meaningful details improves the specified skills. This does not reveal secret NPC information, compel confessions, or turn guesses into facts.

Field Medic.name: Field Medic
Field Medic.description: +2 Medicine and +1 Perception. Requires prior Medicine training.
Field Medic.traitNarrativeEffects: Improved field care and recognition of visible injuries. Healing still needs actual supplies, time, a feasible procedure, and the governing check or effect; this does not grant Healing Magic or free recovery.

Skilled Diplomat.name: Skilled Diplomat
Skilled Diplomat.description: +2 persuasion and +1 Etiquette. Requires prior Persuasion training.
Skilled Diplomat.traitNarrativeEffects: Negotiation and protocol skills improve. NPCs remain free to disagree and relationships follow actual conduct; no automatic charm, trust, legal authority, or consent is granted.

Practical Artisan.name: Practical Artisan
Practical Artisan.description: +2 Magitech and +1 Alchemy. Requires prior Magitech training.
Practical Artisan.traitNarrativeEffects: Applied workshop training improves magitech and alchemy skills. Actual projects still require tools, ingredients, design, time, and ownership. No free devices, spells, or materials are created.

Trailblazer.name: Trailblazer
Trailblazer.description: +2 survival and +1 athletics. Requires prior Survival training.
Trailblazer.traitNarrativeEffects: Experienced overland travel and practical field endurance improve the specified skills. Journeys still use real routes, travel times, weather and actual supplies; no free teleportation or automatic encounter bypass.

Ember-Hardened.name: Ember-Hardened
Ember-Hardened.description: Take half damage from the fire damage type. This is resistance, not fire immunity.
Ember-Hardened.traitNarrativeEffects: Native fire resistance halves damage explicitly typed fire under Voyage combat rules. It does not grant Fire Magic, immunity to heat-related conditions, or protection from unrelated damage types.

Frost-Hardened.name: Frost-Hardened
Frost-Hardened.description: Take half damage from the ice damage type. This is resistance, not cold immunity.
Frost-Hardened.traitNarrativeEffects: Native ice resistance halves damage explicitly typed ice. It does not grant Ice Magic or prevent every cold-related environmental condition, injury, or other damage type.

Venom-Hardened.name: Venom-Hardened
Venom-Hardened.description: Take half damage from the poisoning damage type. This is resistance, not immunity to poison or disease.
Venom-Hardened.traitNarrativeEffects: Native poisoning resistance halves damage explicitly typed poisoning. It does not cure poison, remove an existing disease, negate separate statuses, or guarantee safety from exposure.

Arcane Ward.name: Arcane Ward
Arcane Ward.description: Take half damage from the arcane damage type. Does not grant a ward spell or protection from every school of magic.
Arcane Ward.traitNarrativeEffects: Native arcane resistance halves damage explicitly typed arcane, but not fire, void, psychic, or other magical damage types. No spell knowledge, Mana reserve, or active ward ability is granted.

Arcane Vessel.name: Arcane Vessel
Arcane Vessel.description: +65 maximum Mana, but -25 maximum Health. A high-capacity, physically fragile specialization.
Arcane Vessel.traitNarrativeEffects: Tradeoff applies only to maximum Mana and Health. It does not exchange current Health for casts, drain vital mana, cause soul shock, or automatically damage the character; actual spells still use their normal costs.

Summoner Bound — Hinae Komori.name: Summoner Bound — Hinae Komori
Summoner Bound — Hinae Komori.description: A familiar bond connects you to Hinae Komori. When your summoner genuinely suffers, you feel a small ache around your heart. The connection does not compel obedience or take away your independence.
Summoner Bound — Hinae Komori.traitNarrativeEffects: The actual summoner is Hinae Komori, never a substitute student. When this person actually suffers, a brief sympathetic ache can touch the bound character’s chest. This is mild narrative sensation, not copied injury, repeated Health loss, a concentration penalty, mind reading, precise remote tracking or an action command. Do not invent offscreen suffering to force a scene. The player remains a person free to refuse commands, travel, decline romance and choose companions. The bond grants no ownership, forced enrollment, powers, keys or instant party membership. Its origin is an anomalous supervised familiar call, not ordinary permission to summon humanoids at will. Preserve actual identity and agreed boundaries.

Akitsuhara Farming Village.name: Akitsuhara Farming Village
Akitsuhara Farming Village.description: You grew up among shared irrigation, seasonal harvests and neighbors who noticed an unattended task. You learned to read the ground and work around weather. Start with +1 survival.
Akitsuhara Farming Village.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up among shared irrigation, seasonal harvests and neighbors who noticed an unattended task. You learned to read the ground and work around weather.

Reed-Valley Childhood.name: Reed-Valley Childhood
Reed-Valley Childhood.description: You grew up among bamboo groves, mill paths and narrow river crossings. Quiet footing and attention to an obscured approach came from ordinary travel. Start with +1 Perception.
Reed-Valley Childhood.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up among bamboo groves, mill paths and narrow river crossings. Quiet footing and attention to an obscured approach came from ordinary travel.

Northern Pass Household.name: Northern Pass Household
Northern Pass Household.description: Your household made a living along Akitsuhara’s colder passes. Planning fuel, shelter and a return route mattered more than the appearance of an easy journey. Start with +1 survival.
Northern Pass Household.traitNarrativeEffects: Your household made a living along Akitsuhara’s colder passes. Planning fuel, shelter and a return route mattered more than the appearance of an easy journey.

Household Service Upbringing.name: Household Service Upbringing
Household Service Upbringing.description: You grew up around the practical work behind a territorial household: deliveries, formal visitors, records and rooms that had to be ready. You learned the uses and limits of courtesy. Start with +1 Etiquette.
Household Service Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up around the practical work behind a territorial household: deliveries, formal visitors, records and rooms that had to be ready. You learned the uses and limits of courtesy.

Dojo Neighborhood Upbringing.name: Dojo Neighborhood Upbringing
Dojo Neighborhood Upbringing.description: The sound of practice was part of your childhood. Watching corrections, cleaning a floor and helping with equipment taught you to notice how people move and learn. Start with +1 Insight.
Dojo Neighborhood Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: The sound of practice was part of your childhood. Watching corrections, cleaning a floor and helping with equipment taught you to notice how people move and learn.

Shrine-Court Upbringing.name: Shrine-Court Upbringing
Shrine-Court Upbringing.description: You grew up near a working shrine and its stream of ordinary visitors. You learned how a ceremony, a private worry and a practical request can occupy the same courtyard. Start with +1 Etiquette.
Shrine-Court Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up near a working shrine and its stream of ordinary visitors. You learned how a ceremony, a private worry and a practical request can occupy the same courtyard.

Road-Theatre Upbringing.name: Road-Theatre Upbringing
Road-Theatre Upbringing.description: You grew up among traveling stages, costume bundles and audiences that changed at every stop. Timing, listening and making a small performance carry became familiar skills. Start with +1 performance.
Road-Theatre Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up among traveling stages, costume bundles and audiences that changed at every stop. Timing, listening and making a small performance carry became familiar skills.

Drakenspire Forge Neighborhood.name: Drakenspire Forge Neighborhood
Drakenspire Forge Neighborhood.description: You grew up among Drakenspire’s workshops and winter deliveries. You learned to compare a repair, a bargain and a piece of workmanship without mistaking ornament for quality. Start with +1 Trade.
Drakenspire Forge Neighborhood.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up among Drakenspire’s workshops and winter deliveries. You learned to compare a repair, a bargain and a piece of workmanship without mistaking ornament for quality.

Drakenspire Caravan Upbringing.name: Drakenspire Caravan Upbringing
Drakenspire Caravan Upbringing.description: Your early life followed mountain supplies, snowbound delays and nights in shared lodges. You learned to prepare for the stretch between safe hearths. Start with +1 survival.
Drakenspire Caravan Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: Your early life followed mountain supplies, snowbound delays and nights in shared lodges. You learned to prepare for the stretch between safe hearths.

Asterveil Canopy Household.name: Asterveil Canopy Household
Asterveil Canopy Household.description: You grew up among Asterveil’s household assembly, landing paths and shared gardens. Recognizing a neighbor’s concern and finding a workable agreement were everyday skills. Start with +1 Insight.
Asterveil Canopy Household.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up among Asterveil’s household assembly, landing paths and shared gardens. Recognizing a neighbor’s concern and finding a workable agreement were everyday skills.

Asterveil Field-Shelter Upbringing.name: Asterveil Field-Shelter Upbringing
Asterveil Field-Shelter Upbringing.description: You grew up around guides, conservatory work and careful journeys between sky-island shelters. You learned to notice a route’s changing conditions before committing to it. Start with +1 Perception.
Asterveil Field-Shelter Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up around guides, conservatory work and careful journeys between sky-island shelters. You learned to notice a route’s changing conditions before committing to it.

Veteran Infantry Soldier.name: Veteran Infantry Soldier
Veteran Infantry Soldier.description: You served through a campaign: long marches, cramped camps and the discipline of holding a line when enthusiasm had gone. You still judge a plan by what ordinary tired people can carry out. Start with +1 Force Combat.
Veteran Infantry Soldier.traitNarrativeEffects: You served through a campaign: long marches, cramped camps and the discipline of holding a line when enthusiasm had gone. You still judge a plan by what ordinary tired people can carry out.

Veteran Skirmisher.name: Veteran Skirmisher
Veteran Skirmisher.description: You learned to move under pressure, choose an approach and leave a bad position before pride made the decision. Old service shaped your timing more than your present occupation. Start with +1 Finesse Combat.
Veteran Skirmisher.traitNarrativeEffects: You learned to move under pressure, choose an approach and leave a bad position before pride made the decision. Old service shaped your timing more than your present occupation.

Former Watch Officer.name: Former Watch Officer
Former Watch Officer.description: You have broken up arguments, watched difficult doors and learned how quickly a crowded street can turn dangerous. Familiar procedure and a steady guard are part of your past. Start with +1 Guarded Combat.
Former Watch Officer.traitNarrativeEffects: You have broken up arguments, watched difficult doors and learned how quickly a crowded street can turn dangerous. Familiar procedure and a steady guard are part of your past.

Former Guild Adventurer.name: Former Guild Adventurer
Former Guild Adventurer.description: You have taken commissions, worked alongside unfamiliar partners and learned the difference between an attractive notice and a feasible journey. Something brought you to a fresh beginning. Start with +1 survival.
Former Guild Adventurer.traitNarrativeEffects: You have taken commissions, worked alongside unfamiliar partners and learned the difference between an attractive notice and a feasible journey. Something brought you to a fresh beginning.

Former Monster Hunter.name: Former Monster Hunter
Former Monster Hunter.description: You have followed signs, waited through poor weather and discovered why a confident description is less useful than a clear track. Preparation still shapes how you read a place. Start with +1 Perception.
Former Monster Hunter.traitNarrativeEffects: You have followed signs, waited through poor weather and discovered why a confident description is less useful than a clear track. Preparation still shapes how you read a place.

Expedition Survivor.name: Expedition Survivor
Expedition Survivor.description: A difficult expedition taught you to manage injury, limited supplies and frightened companions. You remember the small practical decisions that made returning possible. Start with +1 Medicine.
Expedition Survivor.traitNarrativeEffects: A difficult expedition taught you to manage injury, limited supplies and frightened companions. You remember the small practical decisions that made returning possible.

Former Mercenary.name: Former Mercenary
Former Mercenary.description: You once sold your fighting work, shared camp with people whose loyalties differed and learned to ask exactly what a patron meant by protection. Start with +1 Force Combat.
Former Mercenary.traitNarrativeEffects: You once sold your fighting work, shared camp with people whose loyalties differed and learned to ask exactly what a patron meant by protection.

Former Arena Fighter.name: Former Arena Fighter
Former Arena Fighter.description: You have fought before a crowd, recovered from public defeat and learned how to keep your movement controlled when an audience wants a spectacle. Start with +1 Finesse Combat.
Former Arena Fighter.traitNarrativeEffects: You have fought before a crowd, recovered from public defeat and learned how to keep your movement controlled when an audience wants a spectacle.

Former Field Medic.name: Former Field Medic
Former Field Medic.description: You have worked beside exhausted travelers or fighters, triaged an injury and cared for someone without promising a miracle. Those habits remain useful beyond the field. Start with +1 Medicine.
Former Field Medic.traitNarrativeEffects: You have worked beside exhausted travelers or fighters, triaged an injury and cared for someone without promising a miracle. Those habits remain useful beyond the field.

Former Bandit.name: Former Bandit
Former Bandit.description: You once lived by a road crew’s threats, stolen goods and unreliable loyalties. Whether you regret it, justify it or simply left, you know how a nervous lookout behaves. Start with +1 Stealth.
Former Bandit.traitNarrativeEffects: You once lived by a road crew’s threats, stolen goods and unreliable loyalties. Whether you regret it, justify it or simply left, you know how a nervous lookout behaves.

Smuggling Past.name: Smuggling Past
Smuggling Past.description: You have carried goods through unwanted attention, trusted the wrong handover and learned to recognize a price that conceals somebody else’s risk. Start with +1 Trade.
Smuggling Past.traitNarrativeEffects: You have carried goods through unwanted attention, trusted the wrong handover and learned to recognize a price that conceals somebody else’s risk.

Former Burglar.name: Former Burglar
Former Burglar.description: You have studied occupied buildings, quiet approaches and the habits of people who assume their belongings are safe. Your present use of that knowledge is yours to decide. Start with +1 Stealth.
Former Burglar.traitNarrativeEffects: You have studied occupied buildings, quiet approaches and the habits of people who assume their belongings are safe. Your present use of that knowledge is yours to decide.

Former Confidence Trickster.name: Former Confidence Trickster
Former Confidence Trickster.description: You have sold a convincing account, watched a mark hesitate and learned how a pleasing detail can distract from the real question. Start with +1 Deception.
Former Confidence Trickster.traitNarrativeEffects: You have sold a convincing account, watched a mark hesitate and learned how a pleasing detail can distract from the real question.

Time Served.name: Time Served
Time Served.description: You have lived through confinement, learned the informal rules of shared quarters and noticed how people negotiate a small amount of freedom. That experience is in your past. Start with +1 Insight.
Time Served.traitNarrativeEffects: You have lived through confinement, learned the informal rules of shared quarters and noticed how people negotiate a small amount of freedom. That experience is in your past.

Iwatsugu Clan Upbringing.name: Iwatsugu Clan Upbringing
Iwatsugu Clan Upbringing.description: You grew up as an ordinary member of Clan Iwatsugu in Drakenspire, around household obligations, stonework and arguments about which shared repair should come first. Your own branch and family life can be defined as part of your story. Start with +1 Trade.
Iwatsugu Clan Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up as an ordinary member of Clan Iwatsugu in Drakenspire, around household obligations, stonework and arguments about which shared repair should come first. Your own branch and family life can be defined as part of your story.

Yukinose Clan Upbringing.name: Yukinose Clan Upbringing
Yukinose Clan Upbringing.description: You grew up as an ordinary member of Clan Yukinose in Drakenspire, among winter provisions, carrier news and hospitality that could carry an obligation. Your place in that large household leaves room for your own ambitions. Start with +1 survival.
Yukinose Clan Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up as an ordinary member of Clan Yukinose in Drakenspire, among winter provisions, carrier news and hospitality that could carry an obligation. Your place in that large household leaves room for your own ambitions.

Arashimine Clan Upbringing.name: Arashimine Clan Upbringing
Arashimine Clan Upbringing.description: You grew up as an ordinary member of Clan Arashimine in Drakenspire, around equipment trials, service commitments and exacting practice. Household expectations are familiar, even if you chose a different direction. Start with +1 Guarded Combat.
Arashimine Clan Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up as an ordinary member of Clan Arashimine in Drakenspire, around equipment trials, service commitments and exacting practice. Household expectations are familiar, even if you chose a different direction.

Crescent Sanctuary Upbringing.name: Crescent Sanctuary Upbringing
Crescent Sanctuary Upbringing.description: You grew up around Drakenspire’s dragon observances, ancestral stories and the practical work of receiving pilgrims. You learned to recognize a solemn occasion and the ordinary person who needs help beside it. Start with +1 Etiquette.
Crescent Sanctuary Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up around Drakenspire’s dragon observances, ancestral stories and the practical work of receiving pilgrims. You learned to recognize a solemn occasion and the ordinary person who needs help beside it.

Mountain Herding Household.name: Mountain Herding Household
Mountain Herding Household.description: Your Drakenspire household raised goats or sheep along difficult slopes. You learned to read an animal’s unease, judge a shelter and bring a wandering charge home. Start with +1 Animal Handling.
Mountain Herding Household.traitNarrativeEffects: Your Drakenspire household raised goats or sheep along difficult slopes. You learned to read an animal’s unease, judge a shelter and bring a wandering charge home.

Winter Stores Community.name: Winter Stores Community
Winter Stores Community.description: You grew up around Drakenspire’s shared stores, distribution queues and neighbors making supplies last. Counting fairly and noticing a strained household became everyday habits. Start with +1 Insight.
Winter Stores Community.traitNarrativeEffects: You grew up around Drakenspire’s shared stores, distribution queues and neighbors making supplies last. Counting fairly and noticing a strained household became everyday habits.

Mountain Rescue Upbringing.name: Mountain Rescue Upbringing
Mountain Rescue Upbringing.description: People in your Drakenspire household helped bring lost or injured travelers back from the passes. You learned to watch conditions, prepare a line and take a small warning seriously. Start with +1 Perception.
Mountain Rescue Upbringing.traitNarrativeEffects: People in your Drakenspire household helped bring lost or injured travelers back from the passes. You learned to watch conditions, prepare a line and take a small warning seriously.

Self-Taught Spell Experimenter.name: Self-Taught Spell Experimenter
Self-Taught Spell Experimenter.description: Before formal instruction, you spent spare evenings taking simple spells apart, changing one detail and finding out why the result misbehaved. You learned to keep experiments small and notice which change mattered. Start with +1 Spellcraft.
Self-Taught Spell Experimenter.traitNarrativeEffects: You have experience with small personal spell experiments and the patience to test one change at a time. This is practical familiarity, not an academic qualification or a ready-made spell.

Outfit — Phoenix Wing uniform.name: Outfit — Phoenix Wing uniform
Outfit — Phoenix Wing uniform.description: Phoenix Wing Academy’s crimson red uniform with an embroidered a phoenix bird with spread wings crest; choose an individual cut and accessories.
Outfit — Phoenix Wing uniform.traitNarrativeEffects: In the final portrait brief, explicitly describe Phoenix Wing Academy clothing: substantial crimson red cloth panels and one embroidered pictorial a phoenix bird with spread wings crest on breast, collar or shoulder. Use a student cut, or an instructor’s coat/robes if the actual character is faculty. No lettering. Preserve the person and selected accessories. This is a cosmetic outfit, not membership, employment, inventory or a mechanical bonus.

Angling Basics.name: Angling Basics
Angling Basics.description: Familiar with rigging a rod, feeling a bite and bringing a small fish safely to hand.
Angling Basics.traitNarrativeEffects: Familiar with rigging a rod, feeling a bite and bringing a small fish safely to hand.

Rare Fish on the Line.name: Rare Fish on the Line
Rare Fish on the Line.description: Something unusual is pulling at your fishing line. Keep its movements in mind: patience, a change of angle or a well-timed pull may bring it within reach. You can also let it go.
Rare Fish on the Line.traitNarrativeEffects: Something unusual is pulling at your fishing line. Keep its movements in mind: patience, a change of angle or a well-timed pull may bring it within reach. You can also let it go.

Fishing Starter Kit.name: Fishing Starter Kit
Fishing Starter Kit.description: An ash rod with reusable spinner, eight portions of bait and a waterproof field ledger for a quiet afternoon beside the water.
Fishing Starter Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: An ash rod with reusable spinner, eight portions of bait and a waterproof field ledger for a quiet afternoon beside the water.

Beastfae.name: Beastfae
Beastfae.description: A rare people with fully animal-shaped faces and upright bodies. Choose a furred, scaled or feathered form, adult stature, colors and clothing. Individuals belong to many communities. Starting benefits: +1 Empathy, +2 Survival and +10 Health capacity.
Beastfae.traitNarrativeEffects: Preserve the chosen animal face, body covering, hands, feet and tail in portraits and play. Beastfae are a distinct rare ancestry, with no compulsory occupation, personality or magical affinity. The native bonuses apply once.

Summoned one.name: Summoned one
Summoned one.description: You woke in another body with the memories of your previous life intact. So far, you alone know what happened to you.
Summoned one.traitNarrativeEffects: Private origin. Preserve the player’s actual past-life memories and chosen present body. NPCs know only what they observe or learn. The origin itself grants no publicly known identity, automatic mastery or allegiance.

Traced Shore Record.description: A real shore report has connected your rescued identity and whereabouts to the people asking questions. It says nothing by itself about your memories or where you came from.
